title: Sounds Like Fun- Hot Tub & Rooftop Views
description:
Welcome to Sounds Like Fun, a 4-story Nashville retreat built for groups who want space, comfort, and nonstop entertainment. This 4-bedroom, 4-bath home sleeps up to 12 guests and is located just 10 minutes from Downtown and Broadway. Whether you're visiting for concerts, celebrations, or a getaway with friends and family, this stay delivers the perfect balance of relaxation, convenience, and fun-filled amenities including a rooftop hot tub, skyline views, mini golf, cornhole, and more!

The space
What We Love About Sounds Like Fun Nashville...
*Rooftop hot tub, mini golf, cornhole, firepit, and skyline views create the ultimate hangout space
*Spacious four-story layout gives large groups room to spread out comfortably
*Located minutes from Broadway, Nissan Stadium, top restaurants, and Nashville nightlife
*Game-friendly amenities including an Infinity game table, Smart TVs, and rooftop entertainment
*Four full bathrooms means everyone has room to get ready without the wait

Step inside and experience a Nashville stay designed for groups who want to enjoy the city together while still having room to relax and recharge. The open-concept main living area creates a welcoming space to gather after a day exploring Music City. Comfortable seating, Nashville-inspired decor, and a large Smart TV make it easy to kick back with your crew, stream your favorite shows, or recap the night’s adventures before heading back out. The coffee table features an Infinity Game Table with digital favorites like Monopoly, Scrabble, Trivial Pursuit, and more for endless group fun.

The fully stocked kitchen is ready for everything from quick breakfasts to late-night snacks and group dinners. Stainless steel appliances, generous prep space, and bar seating for eight make it easy for everyone to stay connected while cooking, dining, or enjoying takeout from one of Nashville’s legendary hot chicken or BBQ spots. Complimentary coffee and a Keurig coffee maker help start every morning right before heading into the city.

Each bedroom is thoughtfully designed with comfort in mind, giving guests private spaces to unwind after busy days and lively nights. The ground-level bedroom features queen bunk beds with two firm mattresses and an attached full bathroom, making it ideal for larger groups or families traveling together. On the main level (second floor), you'll find a king bedroom with a firm mattress and a full bathroom that offers both private access from the bedroom and convenient access from the main living area. The third floor features a king bedroom with a beautifully appointed ensuite bathroom, as well as an additional bedroom with two double beds and a private ensuite bathroom. Both third-floor bedrooms feature plush mattresses for a softer sleeping experience. A sofa sleeper in the living room provides additional sleeping flexibility for the guest who just needs a place to crash.

The rooftop patio truly sets this home apart and serves as the centerpiece of the experience. Spend evenings soaking in the six-person hot tub while enjoying views of the Nashville skyline, gather around the firepit with drinks in hand, or challenge friends to rooftop mini golf and cornhole tournaments before heading out to Broadway. Whether you’re starting the day with coffee or ending the night under the city lights, the rooftop space creates memorable moments for every group.

Additional conveniences throughout the home include high-speed Wi-Fi, Smart TVs in every bedroom and living area, washer and dryer access, garage parking for two standard vehicles, Pack-n-Play and highchair for families, and sound machines in every bedroom for added comfort and restful sleep.

Sounds like Fun offers easy access to everything visitors come to experience in Music City. Broadway, Downtown Nashville, Nissan Stadium, the Country Music Hall of Fame, and the Ryman Auditorium are all just minutes away, making it simple to enjoy concerts, sporting events, museums, restaurants, and nightlife without spending your trip stuck in traffic. The Grand Ole Opry, Opry Mills Mall, and Nashville International Airport are also conveniently nearby. The neighborhood itself is residential, safe, and practical for travelers looking for a comfortable and convenient home base while exploring the city.

By staying with us, you’re also giving back — we donate a portion of every stay to the United Way of Greater Nashville to support programs that strengthen our local community.

Whether you’re planning a celebration, concert weekend, family getaway, or Nashville adventure with friends, Sounds Like Fun delivers the ideal mix of comfort, entertainment, and location. Book your stay today and experience rooftop views, hot tub nights, and unforgettable Music City memories!

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire property.

Other things to note
★Before You Arrive★
We want your arrival to be as easy and seamless as possible. After booking, you’ll receive a short Rental Agreement from our local management team to review and sign electronically before your stay. This quick step helps us make sure everything is in place for your arrival while protecting you, the home, and the homeowners who make your stay possible.

★Damage Waiver★
You are renting a private home. Please treat the property with the respect you would like shown to your own home. We get that accidents happen – some more sober than others – and we want you to be aware of your Damage Waiver coverage should something get a little wild during your stay. In an attempt to make this easier for you, the Damage Waiver fee is included in your cleaning fee. Here’s how it works: by booking with Stay Local Nashville, Inc., you understand and accept that your booking fees include a Damage Waiver. It is the Guests’ responsibility (that’s you!) to report damage that is caused to the Property during your stay. The vacation rental Damage Waiver is not insurance, but instead an agreement by Stay Local Nashville, Inc., to replace or repair unintentional damages up to $1,000.00 (one thousand dollars) in total to the rental unit’s interior. Damages that qualify for this agreement must occur during a Guest’s reservation, be disclosed to management prior to check out, and the Damage Waiver must have been paid in full prior to arrival (don’t worry, it’s wrapped into the cleaning fee!). Any damages that either exceed $1,000.00 (one thousand dollars), are not disclosed prior to check out, or are deemed intentional, will be charged to the credit card on file, through the Airbnb resolution center. The Damage Waiver does not include theft or intentional or negligent damage and will not be covered by this fee and the Guest will be liable for all costs associated with intentional or negligent damage. The Guest is liable for any and all costs and fees associated with the vacation rental, including reasonable collection costs and attorney’s fees that are in any way associated with the Guest’s and/or the Guest’s invitee’s breach of this agreement, including but not limited to, money owned under this agreement for damage to the premises, fees, and/or fines.

★NoiseAware Disclaimer★
Welcome to our respectful and responsible community. We are pleased to inform you that this property is committed to Rent Responsibly standards. This means we follow best-in-class guidelines to ensure you have a peaceful, safe, and memorable stay with us. Please be mindful of our neighbors during your stay. The property’s quiet hours are in place to ensure that you and our whole community can enjoy a restful night’s sleep. We are dedicated to protecting our guests and neighbors from bothersome levels of noise. In an effort to do so, this property is equipped with NoiseAware technology. NoiseAware is a smart home device that measures volume levels throughout the property and allows us to respond to noise nuisances without disrupting your stay. NoiseAware is privacy compliant and is required on this property. NoiseAware is here for your benefit. It helps protect you from aggravating noise from nearby renters or neighbors, as well as proactively prevents noise complaints. If you have any questions please ask. We are committed to your comfort so please let us know if we can do anything during your stay to make it more enjoyable.
